title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Payment Integrity) Bill 2017
short_title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Payment Integrity) Bill 2017

speeches.speaker: Christian Porter
speeches.brief: The bill introduces four measures to improve welfare payment integrity: strengthening residency requirements for Age Pension and Disability Support Pension from July 2018, ceasing the basic pension supplement for overseas recipients after six weeks from January 2018, increasing the income test taper for higher-income Family Tax Benefit Part A families from July 2018, and extending the maximum liquid assets waiting period from 13 to 26 weeks from September 2018. The measures are estimated to save $800 million over the forward estimates.
